meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管好代码工作树和终端,把任务交接给下一个智能体继续做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时开多个代码分支并行干活,还要在智能体之间来回交接任务
copy.tagline_en: Manage worktrees and terminals from the command line, hand tasks off to another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run parallel branches and pass tasks between agents

howto.what: Claude 会改用 `orca` CLI 来操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、仓库、产物和内置浏览器:先确定本会话该用哪个可执行文件,再拉取版本匹配的指南,然后执行命令;命令失败时报告原始错误并停下。
howto.when: 当你说 "$orca-cli"、"Orca worktree"、"handoff" 等,或要在 worktree 里启动 codex/claude、读写 Orca 终端时触发;涉及 Orca 状态时优先用它,而非原生 git worktree。

say.text: 用 orca 开一个子 worktree,并在里面启动 codex
say.note: 会先解析本会话的可执行文件

say.text: 读一下 Orca 终端最近的输出
say.note: 会先加载版本匹配的指南

say.text: 把这个任务 handoff 给另一个 agent
say.note: 走 Orca 的交接入口

howto.what_en: Claude switches to the `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, artifacts and Orca's embedded browser: it resolves the executable for the session, loads the version-matched guide, then runs commands and stops on errors.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff", or when spawning codex/claude in a worktree or reading Orca terminals; preferred over raw git worktree whenever Orca state is involved.

say_en.text: Open a child worktree with orca and start codex inside it
Read the latest output from the Orca terminal
Hand this task off to another agent
